newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 27.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 27.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones fell 19.38 points to 6,528.41. PLDT's ADR was down $0 5/8 at $59.
* On Tuesday, the peso closed on Tuesday at 26.266 to a U.S. dollar from 26.278.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,074.28, down 30.18.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate was down at 10.90625 pct from 11.34375 pct.
* Digital Telecommunications Phils Inc is set to list 1.2 billion primary shares worth 3.0 pesos each when they were offered to the public last month.
* Sun Hung Kai Securities and Dharmala Securities recommend early positioning ahead of the announcement of the nine-month gross national product.
* Manila Bulletin says Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co is raising some $250 million from international capital market by January next year.
* Standard and Poor's Corp assigns new ratings to 14 Philippine banks.
* Today says the Central Bank lowers its overnight borrowing rate by a quarter percentage point to 10.75 percent from 11.0 percent.
